gone.context: Category page: the category was deleted.

othersAllowance.message: {name} to czyjeś kieszonkowe: tylko ta osoba widzi, co w nim jest.
othersAllowance.context: Category page: the category {name} is another person's private allowance.

history.context: Category page: heading of the pane with the category's past months.

historyEmpty.one: Nic nie zapisano w „{name}” w ostatnim miesiącu.
historyEmpty.few: Nic nie zapisano w „{name}” w ostatnich {count} miesiącach.
historyEmpty.many: Nic nie zapisano w „{name}” w ostatnich {count} miesiącach.
historyEmpty.other: Nic nie zapisano w „{name}” w ostatnich {count} miesiąca.
historyEmpty.context: Category page > History: nothing was spent in category {name}.

lastMonths.context: Category page > History: small note next to the heading, the period shown. Lowercase.

typicalMonth.context: Category page > History: stat label, what the category usually costs a month.

noData.context: Category page: a stat without enough data.

last3.context: Category page > History: small line under 'Typical month': averaged over the last 3 complete months. Lowercase, short.

lastMonth.context: Category page > History: stat label when last month's name isn't known.

highest.context: Category page > History: stat label, the most expensive month.

chartLabel.context: Category page: accessible label of the monthly bar chart.

monthLimit.context: Category page: chart legend for the dashed limit line; {month} is the month name alone.

showAll.context: Category page > History: button that lists every month instead of the last three.

limitFor.context: Budget planner, one category opened: label of the limit field; {month} is the name alone.

lastYear.context: Category page, planning ahead: chart column for the same month last year, e.g. 'Dec last yr'. Very short.

plan.context: Category page, planning ahead: chart column for the planned limit.

planFor.context: Category page, planning ahead: pane heading; {month} is the name alone.

planChartLabel.context: Category page, planning ahead: accessible label of the chart.

forecastFor.context: Category page: pane heading for the current month.

projected.context: Category page: stat label, projected month-end spending.

none.context: Category page: stat value when there's no limit.

perDay.context: Category page: how much can be spent per day to stay within the limit.

endedAt.context: Category page, past month without a limit.

nothingYet.message: W tym miesiącu nic tu jeszcze nie wydano.

paceAbout.message: W tym tempie ok. {amount} na koniec miesiąca.
paceAbout.context: Category page, current month without a limit.

paceOver.message: W tym tempie skończy się ok. {amount} ponad limitem.

paceUnder.message: W tym tempie skończy się ok. {amount} poniżej limitu.

plannedNoHistory.message: Zaplanowane na {amount}. Nie ma jeszcze pełnego miesiąca do porównania.

plannedAbove.message: Zaplanowane {amount} powyżej typowego miesiąca, więc jest zapas.

plannedBelow.message: Zaplanowane {amount} poniżej typowego miesiąca, więc trzeba będzie ograniczyć wydatki.

shareOfPlan.context: Category page: pane heading, the category's share of the month's planned spending.

shareOfSpending.context: Category page: pane heading, the category's share of the month's spending.

noLimits.context: Category page > Share of the plan: empty state.

nothingSpent.context: Category page > Share of spending: empty state for a past month.

nothingSpentYet.message: Jeszcze nic nie wydano w miesiącu {month}.
nothingSpentYet.context: Category page > Share of spending: empty state for the current month.

shareOfPlanLine.message: {percent} tego, co plan na {month} przewiduje na wydatki.
shareOfPlanLine.context: Category page > Share of the plan: e.g. '12% of what October plans to spend.' Keep the <b> tags.

shareOfSpendingLine.context: Category page > Share of spending: e.g. '12% of September’s spending.' Keep the <b> tags.

nothingPlannedIn.context: Category page > Share of the plan: the category has no limit this month.

nothingSpentIn.message: Nic nie wydano w „{name}” w miesiącu {month}.
nothingSpentIn.context: Category page > Share of spending: the category has no spending this month.

usually.context: Category page > Share: the usual share over recent months.

hiddenSmaller.context: Category page > Share: how many small categories are left out of the list.

leftOut.context: Category page > Share: categories left out of the comparison, like in the 'Where it goes' donut. {names} is a comma-separated list.
